invariants.rationale: The method typically expects a non-null JsonValue to clone.
JsonValue represents basic values, objects, or arrays, and must be at least one of these.
JsonValue.type() should always return a non-null enum value, as used in the method's switch.
JsonValue's name can be null or a string of any length.

invariants.expression: src.isValue() == (src.type() == JsonValue.ValueType.stringValue || src.type() == JsonValue.ValueType.doubleValue || src.type() == JsonValue.ValueType.longValue || src.type() == JsonValue.ValueType.booleanValue || src.type() == JsonValue.ValueType.nullValue)
invariants.rationale: isValue() is true iff the type is a primitive or null as matched in the switch statement.
